name: Dragonsoul Knight, Paragon of the Amesha — 'this creature becomes a Dragon, gets +5/+3, and gains flying and trample'
notes: A three-part list: the creature type was lost and the boost was read as a global effect with the whole 'this creature becomes a Dragon,' as its subject. Both abilities are fired: Dragonsoul Knight is a 7/5 Dragon with first strike, flying and trample; Paragon of the Amesha is a 5/5 Angel with first strike, flying and lifelink; Grizzly Bears stands by untouched.
